status_note: JUMPTABLE-PIPELINE-0001 segment 1 bilateral gate: model selection chain, find_normalized call shape, EmulateFunction loader bridge and typed error channels. Locked Ghidra 12.0.4 oracle vs current Rugra candidate; 8/8 observation lines byte-identical, stderr empty on both sides. Module-level projection stays MISMATCH: the stageJumpTable partial-clone environment and generate_ops wiring are segment 2/3 work (pipeline_env_note line).

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: JumpTable::recoverModel/recoverAddresses mutate jt in place and report failure by LowlevelError/JumptableThunkError (Rust: JumpTableRecoveryError::Lowlevel/Thunk with the exact explain text); EmulateFunction::emulatePath returns uintb or throws; recovery errors carry mode 1/2 via the typed channel, never a silent zero address.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: Model chain order is override → CALLOTHER-def JumpAssisted shape gate → JumpBasic → JumpBasic2(initializeStart of the rejected pathMeld) per jumptable.cc:2257-2284; findDeterminingVarnodes DFS advances slot-first then pops; emulatePath executes meld ops from the start index down to 1 (op 0 is the BRANCHIND); buildAddresses iterates jrange values in range order, extra default value last.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: jrange sizes: guarded x yields [0,4) (4 entries) for sel_basic; JumpValuesRangeDefault yields range+1 for sel_basic2_default (5 entries incl. 0x4141 default); loadcounts record the cumulative LOAD count per value (collect=1 path); maxtablesize comes from Architecture::max_jumptable_size (1024 default).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: findSmallestNormal picks the smallest calcRange size (varnodeIndex, maxsize monotone tightening, tie keeps earlier index); the 1-byte-256 guard special case and matchsize early-exit are per cc:1177-1191; address printing uses plain hex offsets with message-embedded addresses normalized to <A> so the two Address printers cannot diverge.
